defect_verification.finding: STILL PRESENT. crates/hsk-studio-interop-psd/src/effects.rs:563-564 at bfa1bbf (`if effects.len() >= MAX_EFFECTS { return Err(EFFECTS_OVER_BUDGET); }` inside the per-instance loop of map_stack, before the shape is known) counted live and switched-off instances together. defect_verification.evidence: red proof below: the new test's first assertion fails on bfa1bbf source with `layer L0: left Lost(effects_over_budget), right CountedOnlyStack(1)` (1 live + 1024 off)

design: category of an instance = counts(stack master switch, layer visible with all groups, instance enabled), the same rule StackShape::of uses (one predicate, effects.rs)

loop: counted instance -> counted += 1, > MAX_EFFECTS_PER_LAYER (64) -> Err(effects_over_budget) at once (admit judges the same number), else kept; switched-off instance -> kept while kept switched-off < MAX_EFFECTS (1024), else dropped; a stack that cannot count (hidden, master-off) refuses at the first dropped one (as before: effects_over_budget before any more of the descriptor is mapped), a stack that can count flags off_dropped and keeps scanning (a counted instance may follow); ordinals come from a separate `mapped` counter so kept instances keep their source ordinal

after the loop: over_stack = off_dropped || kept > 1024; counted == 0 -> Err(effects_over_budget) (a stack of switched-off instances only: the ceiling cuts exactly the category it holds); counted > 0 -> retain the enabled (= counted) instances; admit then judges the shape of what the record holds (uncounted 0), and the Fit becomes CountedOnlyOverStack

proposal.rs: Fit match -> loss note (document bound: effects_unrendered_dropped_over_document_budget, ceiling: effects_unrendered_dropped_over_stack_ceiling, both Transformed, path layer[i]/tagged/lfx2(layer_id=...)); a distinct code because the cause is Folio's per-record ceiling, not a document budget

choice: all switched-off instances of the stack are dropped (not a prefix that would fit), consistent with the R10 lead decision for the uncounted bound (visible stack keeps its live instances, drops its switched-off ones) and with CountedOnly; rendered output is unchanged either way, a switched-off instance renders nothing
behaviour_changes: vs bfa1bbf: a stack with counted instances (<= 64) and counted + switched-off > 1024 imports with its counted instances and a Transformed loss; it was lost whole (Unsupported effects_over_budget). Every other case is unchanged: stacks <= 1024 (whole), > 64 counted (lost), no counted instances > 1024 (lost), document bounds (R10 tally)
new loss code effects_unrendered_dropped_over_stack_ceiling and DESCRIPTOR capability/clause strings (a host reading the loss report sees one new Transformed code)

transient memory while mapping one stack: up to 64 counted + 1024 switched-off instances (was 1024 in all); still one stack at a time and dropped before the next layer; the document-level bound (max_layers + 8192 node need) is unchanged
